**Finding: MINCOMMIT — Compliant (meets the preferred position).**

- **Fees are usage-only.** Article V.II/V.III set "user fees" by reference to "Monthly Notional Volume bands (US$bn) traded on Platform by Licensee" at a per-US$1 million-traded rate, and the monthly amount is calculated on volume actually traded. The only floor is actual recorded usage × the applicable rate — not a committed minimum.
- **No minimum, shortfall, or take-or-pay.** Searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall", "take or pay", "quota", "threshold", "whether or not used" and "guarantee" return nothing operative against us. The descending-rate tiers are pricing bands, not volume caps or targets we must hit (Article V.i(ii) only lowers the rate once a band is reached).
- **Other charges are ordered services or one-off consideration.** The $2,500/month Technical Support Services fee (Article VII(a), with VII(d) confirming no additional support fees), the $35,000 Initial Payment, and the 33% Supplemental Payments revenue share (payable only out of amounts we actually earn from third parties) are all payments for services ordered or usage, not volume commitments.
- **Fallback not engaged**, so no redline was proposed. Noted for the file only (not deviations): the scrivener's error in Article V.III(b) ("payable by the Licensor" where the payer is plainly the Licensee), and the 36-month term with fixed monthly support fee — neither creates a purchase or volume commitment.
